tool_args.rationale: The pilot favors a coupled memory ODE, but the five similarly timed trajectories do not reliably distinguish memory decay from its feedback on the observed state. The fine trajectory batch addresses that ambiguity near the target horizon.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the four-parameter coupled memory ODE immediately
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: All five prefixes share the same switch timing, and their forecast horizons are similar. A good fit could leave the memory timescale and coupling strength poorly distinguished.
The endpoint-matched history gap and transient lag favor an explicit memory state over an endpoint-only law.
It costs less but targets branch ambiguity rather than the temporal measurements needed to separate memory from slow relaxation.
